mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced cost of capital, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets during monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals economic deterioration and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to earnings downgrades and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term coefficient in regression has p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%) drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings momentum and investor confidence in economic resilience.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 0.3% month-over-month signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.3%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 850,000 units indicate weakening residential demand and broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced consumer confidence and sector-specific earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 850, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100 (INDPRO < 100) reflects manufacturing contraction and reduced economic output, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through sector-wide earnings revisions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding manufacturing activity and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through improved corporate visibility and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
